help: Set the scope kinds, cleanup rules and secret handling for the memory that agents and people share.

secrets.label: Secret handling
secrets.none: There's no option to save secrets as they are.

reject.title: Reject save
reject.body: If the content looks like a secret, it isn't saved and an error comes back. The agent gets a “secret rejected” result.

redact.title: Mask and save
redact.body: Saves the content with the secret-looking parts masked. Masked lines can't be recovered. The agent may not know they were masked.

kinds.title: Scope kinds ({n})
kinds.label: Scope kind list
kinds.emptyBody: Without a scope kind, agents can't write to memory. Entries people created stay.
kinds.loadFailed: Couldn't load the scope kind list
kinds.defaultsPending: The default scope kind list updates when you save the settings.
kinds.confirmBody_one: The {count} entry of this kind stays. In Memory it shows as an “unknown scope kind” (or off), and agents can't write to it. Resources that use this kind get a warning.
kinds.confirmBody_other: The {count} entries of this kind stay. In Memory they show as an “unknown scope kind” (or off), and agents can't write to them. Resources that use this kind get a warning.

kindEditor.label: Label
kindEditor.templateHelp: Leave it empty for a scope with no scope id (everyone shares one scope). A template whose values are empty can't be used in that run.
kindEditor.idHelp: You can't change it after creating. If a default or plugin kind has the same id, this overrides it.
kindEditor.idTaken: This id is already used. Applying changes that kind.
kindEditor.checkFailed: Couldn't check. You can still apply.

retention.title: Cleanup rules ({n})
retention.help: Rules are checked from the top, and only the first one that matches is applied. No rule applies to pinned entries.
retention.emptyBody: Nothing is archived or deleted automatically.
retention.label: Cleanup rule list
retention.autoOff: Automatic run is off — it runs only with [Apply now]
retention.autoDelete: Delete rules apply automatically every {every}. When you change a rule, check its targets with a preview first.

blocked.targetChanged: The target store changed. Preview again.

retention.confirmBody: Processing {n}: archive {a}, delete (mark as deleted) {d}. You can undo archiving and deleting from the entry history.

limits.title: Administrator limits (read-only)
limits.note: These values are set when the server starts, so you can't change them here (`modules.options` in the settings file).

scopeKindWidget.offHelp: The memory feature is off, so the list can't load. Once it's on, you can choose from the list.
scopeKindWidget.loadFailed: Couldn't load the scope kind list. You can enter the id yourself.
